about:
Southern Packaging Inc. operates from a 65-acre facility on US Highway 190 in Port Allen, Louisiana, situated on the Mississippi River Industrial Corridor. A second 25-acre site in Woodville, Mississippi, provides access to hardwood and pine timber. The company serves national manufacturers, industrial firms, and petrochemical plants across the Gulf Coast, with a fleet of more than 50 trailers enabling delivery from Texas to Mississippi.

The company manufactures custom pallets, skids, and crates, controlling the process from raw lumber through finished product. On-site sawmills and scragg mills process hardwood and pine logs into components using circular saws, edger saws, gang saws, band saws, and automated stackers. Ten computer-assisted Viking nailing machines handle high-volume assembly, while specialty orders are hand-nailed. Two heat-treatment chambers and six kilns can treat 25 to 30 truckloads per day to meet ISPM-15 export requirements, and kiln drying with an EPA-registered water-based mold inhibitor is also available.

Customers include large chemical and industrial operations such as Dow Chemical, which has relied on Southern Packaging for three decades. The company serves petrochemical, manufacturing, and export markets, offering both new and recycled stringer pallets, as well as combo pallets that blend new and reclaimed lumber. Pallet design services are provided through a licensed Pallet Design System (PDS) for custom engineering and testing.

Southern Packaging emphasizes vertical integration—owning its lumber supply and processing equipment—to avoid supply-chain disruptions and ensure consistent quality. Its dual-location footprint supports emergency preparedness, and the firm highlights immediate delivery from inventory and same-day response for urgent needs.
